integrity: The source equations, parameter sign assumptions, publication date and MSC were checked in the publisher full text. The exponential-coordinate identity was derived directly and replayed by the bundled exact-arithmetic checker; infinite-time conclusions use an analytic variation-of-constants argument rather than finite simulation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the unshifted capacitor-only model (System (12)) with positive n and alpha*d. It constrains bounded complete trajectories and compactly supported invariant measures; it does not prove existence or boundedness of an attractor for arbitrary initial data, and offset-boosted variants require a separate transformed equation.
title: Exact positive-filter geometry of the capacitor-only memristive Colpitts state
